scenes.title: Your Natural Face Is Lovely
scenes.summary: Alone on set with the shy newcomer who stepped in for Kuroki, Muranishi tells her to cast off every rule binding her, gives her a brand-new stage name, and guides her debut leap.

scenes.title: Satellite Launch and Studio Farewell
scenes.summary: At the satellite launch reception, the company President warns Muranishi he will pull the plug at any sign of trouble, while back at the studio a veteran female director packs up and bids the young crew farewell.

scenes.title: Starting Fresh in a Small Apartment
scenes.summary: While Muranishi interviews his new star on camera, the departing female director says goodbye to him and welcomes Kuroki into her cozy apartment where both women vow to live freely.

scenes.title: Hiding Next Door with Kawada
scenes.summary: Tracked down at their hotel by rival gangsters after the shootout, Toshi and the young hostess duck into a neighboring room to hide—and stumble straight into Kawada.

scenes.title: Escaping a Colorless Commute
scenes.summary: While veteran actresses grumble that the new star could never replace Kuroki, she tells Muranishi about running into an old coworker and how leaving her dull routine gave her real freedom.

scenes.title: Fifty Million Short in the Safe
scenes.summary: As unpaid studio bills mount, Muranishi orders the office safe opened and discovers that massive satellite expenses have left the company fifty million yen short of this month's broadcast fee.

scenes.title: The Lending Freeze and Six Days Left
scenes.summary: A sudden government cap on real-estate lending forces the bank Section Chief to freeze all loans as Japan's bubble bursts, cutting Muranishi off with only six days until his payment deadline.

scenes.title: Not Cut Out to Be a Yakuza
scenes.summary: After the hostess's desperate mother pounds on Kawada's door begging to start over, Toshi urges the weeping hostess to think of her own happiness before she quietly leaves him in the night.

scenes.title: Borrowing Every Last Yen
scenes.summary: Scrambling to cover the fifty-million-yen gap, Muranishi raids an actress's thirty-million-yen tax reserve, delays crew wages, and borrows his young assistant's personal savings.

scenes.title: Settling the Debt in Blood
scenes.summary: Captured by Furuya's gang, Toshi faces a three-hundred-million-yen ransom; when Kawada offers his entire four-hundred-million-yen fortune and Furuya demands five hundred million, Toshi sacrifices his own finger to pay the rest.

scenes.title: Pitching a One-Night Strip Show
scenes.summary: Still millions short, Muranishi rallies his actresses to perform a live strip show as fan promotion, and the accountant persuades the exempted new star to join them rather than stand apart.

scenes.title: Four Hours Until Curtain
scenes.summary: With four hours until showtime, a fiery veteran dance instructor tells Muranishi's actresses that her stage is no place for amateurs, provoking them into giving everything they have in rehearsal.

scenes.title: A Packed House and an Empty Safe
scenes.summary: Muranishi hosts the sold-out strip show and celebrates hitting the full 250 million yen—only to return to a dark office and discover his accountant and young assistant have fled with the entire safe.
scenes.location: packed theater and looted studio office
